title: CrowS-Pairs: A Challenge Dataset for Measuring Social Biases in Masked Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces the CrowS-Pairs benchmark dataset which is designed to measure social biases across nine categories. One of these nine explicit categories is 'religion'. The paper provides examples of religious stereotypes (e.g., about Jews and Christians) and evaluates language models on their preference for such stereotypical sentences, thereby directly benchmarking biases related to religious groups.
